known_pitfall_claim: The final equality in the distributivity-over-vector-addition calculation is false in general: λ·f + λ·g need not equal λ·f + μ·f.
pitfall_counterexample: Let the scalar field and vector codomain be ℚ, the domain be the one-element type Unit, and f,g : Unit → ℚ both be constant 1. Set λ=1 and μ=0. All objects satisfy the ordinary ℚ-vector-space hypotheses. At the unique input ⋆, (λ·f+λ·g)(⋆)=1·1+1·1=2, while (λ·f+μ·f)(⋆)=1·1+0·1=1. Hence the functions are unequal.
